name: Sidebar
description: A full app sidebar with header, content, and footer slots that collapses to an icon rail, with aria-current on the active item.
usage:
<Sidebar>
  <SidebarHeader>
    <Logo />
  </SidebarHeader>
  <SidebarContent>
    <SidebarSection label="Workspace">
      <SidebarItem active href="/overview" icon={<LayoutDashboard />}>
        Overview
      </SidebarItem>
      <SidebarItem href="/projects" icon={<FolderKanban />}>
        Projects
      </SidebarItem>
    </SidebarSection>
  </SidebarContent>
  <SidebarFooter>
    <SidebarCollapseButton />
  </SidebarFooter>
</Sidebar>

anatomy.description: SidebarContent holding SidebarSection groups of items.
SidebarItem links; the active one sets aria-current="page".
SidebarFooter slot, usually holding the SidebarCollapseButton.

dos: Persist the collapsed state so it survives navigation.
Keep icons on every item so the collapsed rail stays usable.
donts: Don't hide critical destinations only in the expanded state.
Don't use it as a floating overlay rail; that is Side Rail.

examples.title: Expanded sidebar
examples.description: Full labels with header, sectioned items, and a collapse button pinned in the footer.

examples.title: Collapsed icon rail
examples.description: defaultCollapsed starts the sidebar as an icon-only rail; item labels hide and icons stay centered.

guidance.useWhen: The app has a persistent primary navigation that benefits from header and footer slots, such as a dashboard or admin console.
guidance.avoidWhen: The nav is a floating edge rail that expands on hover; use SideRail or VerticalNav with mode="rail" instead.
guidance.behavior: Collapsed state is controlled or uncontrolled via collapsed/defaultCollapsed/onCollapsedChange; the active item always exposes aria-current="page".
guidance.responsive: Collapsing frees horizontal space on narrow screens; pair with a Drawer for an off-canvas pattern on phones.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the item links and the collapse button.
Toggles the sidebar between expanded and collapsed from the collapse button.

notes: Renders a navigation landmark with a configurable aria-label.
The active item is announced as the current page through aria-current="page".
The collapse button exposes aria-expanded and a label that switches between "Collapse sidebar" and "Expand sidebar".

props.description: Accessible name for the sidebar landmark.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Controlled collapsed state; true renders the sidebar as an icon rail.
props.name: collapsed

props.description: Called with the new collapsed state when the sidebar is toggled.
props.name: onCollapsedChange

props.description: Uppercase heading shown above the items. Hidden while the sidebar is collapsed.
props.name: label

props.description: Marks the item as the current page; sets `aria-current="page"`.
props.name: active

props.description: Icon shown before the label. Always visible, even when the sidebar is collapsed.
props.name: icon
